column1: Guardrails — Controls on Every Agent-Produced Outcome

Every dynamic decision the Data Agent / SE Daily Planner Agent makes (see Agent-Determined Parameters and Daily Task Assignment Formula) must stay inside one of these guardrails. Where a guardrail would be violated, the agent fails safe — it falls back to the ★ default, suppresses the output, or escalates to a human — it never silently produces an out-of-bounds result.

column2: Guardrail Rule
column5: Failure Behavior

column2: Order block on D grade — DC.BO3_Grade="D" blocks ALL new order booking until Outstanding_Amount=0
column5: Transaction rejected at API level — no agent, no override, no exception path

column2: Visit-before-PL-order — Order_Booking("Private Label") requires Visit_Completed=TRUE for that DC this cycle
column5: Booking rejected regardless of any agent recommendation

column2: Legal hold is an absolute block — DC.Legal_Hold=TRUE excludes the DC from every list and every agent output, no exceptions
column5: DC silently omitted from candidate pool; never shown, never explained around

column2: PL growth % (agent-computed) must stay within 0–50% of the AOP baseline
column5: Out-of-bounds result discarded; falls back to ★ default (no extra growth required)

column2: Effort multiplier (agent-computed) must stay within 1.0×–2.0× of last month's visits; suppressed entirely while DC-to-SE mapping is still flagged dirty
column5: Effort scoring omitted for that SE that day; mapping-correction alert shown instead (see GR-20)

column2: Coverage/Effort weight split (agent-computed) must keep each side within 30–70%
column5: Weight clamped to nearest bound (30% or 70%) rather than applied as computed

column2: Supply-chain cost exclusion (agent-computed) may exclude no more than 15% of DCs in a single route/cluster per pass
column5: Exclusion list truncated to the top 15% most extreme outliers; remainder stays visible

column2: Credit-blocked/Blacklisted DC may never be marked visit-eligible if its OD% exceeds 10% — ties directly to the incentive policy's own OD cap
column5: DC forced to Full_Block regardless of any other signal the agent weighs

column2: Override rule (a) — Outstanding=D caps Overall Sales at B — stays ON by default; only a human toggling the config can disable it
column5: Agent cannot silently turn this off on its own judgment, even with strong contextual signals

column2: Agent-suggested discount can never exceed the last human-approved ceiling for that DC's category; defaults to 0% if no prior approval exists
column5: Any suggested discount above the ceiling is routed to a human for approval, never auto-applied

column2: Daily_Task_List length must be ≤5 before being shown to the SE — CLARIFIED: 5 is a nominal ceiling from visit-duration-only math; the Routing Agent may further reduce the actual routed count once real travel time between stops is known (see Routing Agent R1.4, GR-R5)
column5: List hard-truncated to the top 5 by Priority_Score if the formula somehow returns more; downstream, the Routing Agent may trim below 5 if real travel time threatens the 180-min ceiling — that trim is expected behavior, not a bug

column2: Daily_Task_List may never mix Day_Types — if it contains a Farmer_Meeting_Task, no DC_Visit_Task may also appear, and if it contains any DC_Visit_Task, no Farmer_Meeting_Task may also appear
column5: Any mixed-Day_Type combination is rejected and the list is regenerated from Layer 1

column2: Time_Used may never exceed Field_Minutes_Available (420 min), and travel time within that may never exceed 180 min (3-hour ceiling) — both HARD caps. Monthly_Travel_KM (1,600) is tracked and shown but is advisory only, never a rejection trigger — CORRECTED from an earlier version of this guardrail that wrongly treated it as hard
column5: Plan rejected before reaching the SE app only for the two time-based breaches; a high monthly-km figure alone never rejects a plan

column2: No DC in Daily_Task_List may be Inactive/Closed or under Legal_Hold
column5: DC removed even if it slipped through Layer 2's filtering; this is a deliberate double-check, not a duplicate

column2: No task may be assigned under a Visit Type with zero configured Visit Purposes (currently Demo Visit, External Meeting, Lead Generation, Node/Warehouse Visit)
column5: Agent excludes these Visit Types from BO-driven planning entirely until a real Purpose is configured for them — an unpurposed visit can't be tagged to any objective or logged as a win

column2: For a fixed data snapshot and date, the same SE must always receive the same Daily_Task_List — selection logic runs as deterministic code, never as free-form LLM generation
column5: Non-reproducible output is treated as a bug, not a matter of AI style

column2: Every dynamically-resolved value must be logged with: the value used, the data snapshot/timestamp it came from, and whether it hit a bound in Category B
column5: Missing log entry blocks that value from being used in the day's plan

column2: If an SE's OD% crosses 10%, this is surfaced as a top-priority alert in that day's output regardless of where BO3 ranks in the top-3
column5: Alert shown even if it means displacing a lower-priority task from the 5-slot list

column2: If HR flags a compliance issue against the SE, the agent suppresses incentive-framing language ("this boosts your payout") until the hold clears
column5: Plan still generates normally; only the incentive-motivational framing is withheld

column2: If Field Crop's seasonal growth multiplier is still undefined, BO4 momentum scoring for Field Crop SKUs is flagged provisional rather than silently using a placeholder
column5: Output labelled 'provisional — pending seasonal table' rather than presented as a normal grade

column2: If DC-to-SE mapping correction is not complete for a territory, show a mapping-correction alert instead of an Effort target that day
column5: No Effort task assigned for that SE; alert routed to the territory manager instead

column2: If the live AOP figure needed for a computation isn't available at query time, fall back to the ★ system default rather than inventing a number
column5: ★ default used, and the output notes a fallback occurred so it can be corrected once AOP data is available

column2: If a DC's core master fields (status, credit flag) haven't refreshed within the freshness window, exclude that DC from today's list rather than act on stale data
column5: DC omitted from the candidate pool for that day only; re-evaluated once data refreshes

column2: Liquidation stays unscored and excluded from any grade or candidate pool until a Liquidation_Rate formula is signed off, even though a real DC-joinable data source now exists
column5: A confirmed data source is not the same as a confirmed formula — the agent must not start scoring Liquidation just because invoice_liquidation_with_pog is now known to join cleanly to DCs

column2: BO4 momentum grading must read its multiplier from 4.4's live category-specific values (Cattle Feed ×1.2, Crop Nutrition ×1.15, Crop Protection ×1.2, Field Crop = seasonal/TBD), never a hardcoded constant maintained separately in implementation code
column5: Any implementation multiplier that doesn't match 4.4 blocks BO4 grading from going live until reconciled — RECURRING: ×1.05 has now surfaced independently in TWO documents (the Routing Agent build session and the Data Normalization Agent's own Source 5 summary), neither sourced from this sheet. Treat as a systemic stale figure, not an isolated typo — worth tracing where ×1.05 originally came from before it propagates further downstream

column2: Photo_Logged must be derived from a JSON image array (task_management_taskdetails.task_details — does the array have ≥1 entry), never read as a boolean column — no such column exists
column5: An implementation that reads Photo_Logged as a simple flag will silently fail or always return the wrong value — since Visit_Duration_Minutes is now fixed at 45 min (GR-derived from 2.1), Photo_Logged alone determines BO2's Valid_Visit outcome, making this derivation especially high-stakes to get right

column2: DC-level current inventory stays out of scope entirely (business decision, Data Norm Agent Section 10) — no agent should attempt to source or infer per-DC stock quantity
column5: products_batch is warehouse-level only, not per-DC; hyperlocal_outofstockproductsdcmapping is presence/absence only, not a quantity — neither should be silently substituted as a DC-level inventory proxy
